subject: Coffee at VapiCon?
text:
Hi [NAME],

Given your focus on speech tech/ ASR I thought you might be going to
VapiCon next week. I'd love to say hi over a coffee at the conference and
share perspectives from our recent projects with Speechmatics and Kyutai in
voice AI space.

For context - we help over 200 AI teams improve annotation quality. For ASR
teams, we focus on unifying auto-annotation + human QA for multi-speaker
transcription, diarization, non-speech metadata tagging etc. With the goals
of reducing word error rate and better understanding of
emotional/contextual cues.

Would you be open to a quick chat at VapiCon? I'll be there all day on 2nd
Oct. Can connect virtually too if it is easier.

subject: Coffee at VapiCon?
text:

Saw your recent paper on Long-Form ASR at Interspeech, thought you might be
at VapiCon next week given your research area. I'd love to say hi and share
perspectives from our recent projects with Speechmatics and Kyutai in
similar space to [COMPANY].

I mostly focus on improving data quality for those team. For long-form ASR,
what I've found particularly challenging transcribing is handling
overlapping or stacked speech especially in multi-speaker settings. We're
approaching this by unifying pre-labeling and human QA in one platform.

Would love how you're approaching this if you're open to a chat? I'll be at
VapiCon all day on 2nd Oct. Can connect virtually too if it is easier.

subject: ASR Coffee chat
text:
[NAME] - I saw you work on speech-to-text topics so I wanted to reach out for
a chat. I've been working on similar projects with Speechmatics and Kyutai
and I'd love to hear how you're approaching improving model outcome.

From a data quality perspective, what I've found particularly challenging
is separating non-textual metadata from transcription - e.g. emotional and
contextual cues. We're approaching this by building a UI for separate
speaker tracks, as well trying to automate as much transcription and
diarization as possible.

I'd love to hear how you're approaching this from the point of view of ASR
for autonomous pilot. Would you be open to a 30 min chat?

text:
